calculation_steps: Bound two-time normal propagator with both endpoint factors and tangent shear.

Apply scalar reciprocal comparison and strict tube closure.

result.exact_expression: For I=1 and 31/5<=mu<77511/12500, initial state error <=1/16000000 gives state error <=1/240000 and lifted phase error <1/300000 rad through one native time unit.

counterexamples_and_failures: Phase-zero gain alone is insufficient for errors injected at intermediate phases.
limitations: Finite-time sufficient bound. Coefficient drift, detector error, nonlinear all-time stability, and calibration OPEN.
